amber-4b.disclosure: Measured on the 27 Oct 2026 draw and shown unranked until that draw is equated to the reference scale. Amber 4B at 71c37554758f6df3034aac5c632030a1216a7392 is the decoder alone, distinct from Amber 0.4B and Amber Hybrid 4B. The Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B backbone at 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a was loaded with the author's 522,104,984-byte LoRA adapter and readout, merged natively. The unchanged decoder ran behind a first-party HTTP shim with token-length observation. Native defaults: token_budget=8192, max_batch=16, chunk_tokens=4096, BF16 backbone and FP32 merge/readout. Choice and noul return native probabilities with no generated text or reasoning; score is unsupported and is never converted to choice. Text only. The 8,192-token padded prefill/batch budget is not a context cap: native chunking preserves all tokens and recurrent/KV state. There is no explicit total-context precheck; architectural 262,144 positions do not establish measured capacity. Public probes through 82,000 tokens passed, without establishing unlimited context. Of 1,500 requests, 1,125 answered and 375 returned preregistered HTTP 422 refusals for unsupported score. Unsupported questions follow the frozen scorer's supported-type rule; all requests remain in the cost denominator. No native deviations, retry or response repair occurred. Input: 826,084 processed tokens over answered items, matching the independent offline count, with zero generated output; refusals bill no tokens. One item exceeded 10 s and receives the time-limit treatment without exclusion or retry. Scored loop: 79.13818168640137 s. Displayed self-hosted latency is an estimate under the shared method, not a measured hosted endpoint. Replay: 50 requests, 34 byte-identical, zero argmax flips, reported maximum probability difference 0.0; the byte differences are unexplained. Post-run health was ready. A separate stop-diagnostic file is missing; the retained replay and health receipts remain available. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 declared on the card, with no LICENSE file; non-commercial. Training includes train splits of public datasets that are also sources of index benchmarks. We did not inspect training data or verify overlap with JevBench public or sealed items, so contamination of the sealed draw is unchecked; the training statement does not establish JevBench contamination. One NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96 GB was measured, without establishing a minimum. An earlier preparation attempt stopped before weight download and sealed input on an inherited Torch ABI mismatch. Unused inherited extensions were removed after the locked runtime install; explicit imports, CUDA and public smoke passed without upstream source patches. This completed run had no scored retry.

oenogarum.disclosure: Measured on the 27 Oct 2026 draw and shown unranked until that draw is equated to the reference scale. First measurement of plantwaterer/oenogarum at 9b684d7da38eb200fe4c5d11c36e3ce819ea2cfb, distinct from allec. The author's unchanged LenAvgBayesEngine README entry point ran behind a first-party HTTP shim. Native defaults include a BF16 backbone, CPU FP64 head, max_len and tokens_per_batch 32,768, l_star 939 and averaging enabled. Choice and noul return native probabilities; score is unsupported. Each choice item is read once per option order (four reads); all forwarded prompts are counted in the processed tokens and in cost. Native two-order noul averaging and the multi-round path for menus above 52 options are retained, including 0.001 probability mass on discarded finalists. No generated text, extra host ensemble, retry or answer repair. Text only. Context: every forwarded prompt must include the full normalized state and fit within 32,768 tokens. The shim refuses a request before forwarding when the native renderer would crop the state, and also refuses an alternative forward that would omit the full state or exceed the limit; no truncation or raised cap is used. Maximum answered prompt: 1,306 tokens. Public probes through 4,096 tokens passed; full-cap capacity was not established. Of 1,500 requests, 1,120 answered and 380 returned preregistered HTTP 422 refusals for unsupported score criteria or context/state-shown limits. No unsupported/context subtotal is asserted. Refusals remain misses where their question type is supported; unsupported score questions follow the frozen scorer's supported-type rule. There were no native deviations. Processed input: 739,884 expanded-prefill tokens, matching the independent offline count, with zero generated output. The scored loop took 208.80450177192688 s. Displayed self-hosted latency is an estimate under the shared method, not a measured hosted endpoint. Replay: 50 requests, 33 byte-identical, zero argmax flips and reported maximum probability difference 0.0; this does not establish byte-identical agreement on every request. Post-run health was ready. The model card declares Apache-2.0; no LICENSE file ships in the repository. The card's own training inventory lists corpora under non-commercial, copyleft or research-only terms (e.g. XNLI/translation data). Whether the Apache-2.0 declaration covers that training data is the author's claim and is unverified; commercial use should review the training-data terms. The Decision Index excludes two of its private new-domain tests for this model, reporting signs its training data overlapped them (the lab's claim, carried as such). No JevBench contamination audit was run; there is no evidence of training on JevBench items. Displayed with a non-commercial-style restriction label; this does not establish unrestricted commercial rights. The measured device was one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, not an established minimum. Only this row of the planned pair was measured before cleanup began; no measurement of the other model is claimed. The rented GPU instance was closed and temporary measurement copies were deleted, with no cleanup errors reported.

piccolo-4b.disclosure: Measured on the 27 Oct 2026 draw and shown unranked until that draw is equated to the reference scale. Piccolo 4B at fe6a7af0c6eaf363612c90051243b4e8aeacc90e consists of complete fine-tuned Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B safetensors weights, measured with the author's pinned FlexCompiler and layout through a first-party HTTP shim; no author HTTP server exists. Native flex_twice defaults are preserved: max_context 65,536 and row ceiling 65,535. Full-attention masks use dense BF16 zeros, linear layers are unchanged and candidate embedding readout uses FP32 with temperature 1. Native choice, noul and ordered-score probabilities are returned without generated text or reasoning. Text only. Inputs of up to 3,000 tokens are read twice (a layout derived from FlexDM, MIT notice retained); both reads are counted in the processed tokens and in cost. Rows longer than 65,535 tokens are refused explicitly by the reader and count as wrong answers. Repetition concatenates both copies within one forward, rather than making two independent calls. No chunking, truncation, raised ceiling, host retry, stock-base substitution or answer repair. Of 1,500 requests, 1,495 answered and five returned preregistered native HTTP 422 long-input refusals, counted as misses with zero usage. There were zero usage mismatches or native deviations. Processed input: 1,080,355 tokens, including 543,915 single-read-equivalent tokens and 536,440 second-read tokens; output zero. Every answered input meets the single-read repeat condition. Scored loop: 155.18647408485413 s. Displayed self-hosted latency is an estimate under the shared method, not a measured hosted endpoint. Replay: 50 requests, 49 byte-identical, zero argmax flips and reported maximum probability difference 0.0. The one byte-level difference is unexplained. Post-run health was ready. One NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96 GB was measured, without establishing a minimum. Licence: Apache-2.0 weights; the FlexDM-derived layout retains its MIT notice. The model card reports a JevBench public-split score of 87.01% and does not state whether public benchmark items were used in training or model selection. Author-reported: the 87.01% figure is author-reported, not independently verified or substituted for this measurement. No training examples or overlap with the sealed draw were independently verified. This is the completed run for this revision on this draw, with no scored retry or response repair.

The two Piccolo models used the same VM sequentially. A first-party loopback HTTP shim invoked the pinned compiler and layout at fe6a7af0c6eaf363612c90051243b4e8aeacc90e, with local hash-verified full model files, read-only mounts, empty credentials, offline flags and network cut before sealed input.
